files.celestial_bodies.csv: Earth, Moon, Mars, and Sun constants
files.launch_vehicle_specs.csv: Launch vehicle mass, thrust, size, and payload references
files.propulsion_specs.csv: Chemical and electric propulsion reference fields
files.transfer_reference.csv: Preliminary transfer delta-v and time references
files.source_register.csv: NASA, JPL, and Kaggle source register
files.launch_site_specs.csv: Preliminary launch site coordinates and azimuth ranges
files.rocket_stage_specs.csv: Stage-level mass, thrust, Isp, and burn inputs
files.mission_burn_plan.csv: Mission departure and orbit-insertion burn plan
files.atmospheric_properties.csv: Preliminary atmosphere values for ascent drag

data_classes.official: Copied or normalized from cited NASA, JPL, ULA, or ESA source material
data_classes.aggregator: Launch Library 2 community-curated record; validate before final use
data_classes.derived: Computed from verified constants using ideal two-body or patched-conic equations
data_classes.team design input: Placeholder selected by the project team and must be justified

recommended_validation: JPL Horizons for epoch-dependent planetary positions and velocities
NASA NAIF SPICE for high-precision geometry
NASA GMAT for independent trajectory and orbit propagation checks
Kaggle launch datasets for historical launch-record cross-checks only
